scripts.build: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer"
scripts.dev: npm --prefix ../daemon run build && npm run build:processes && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && SWITCHBOARD_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.package:dir: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never"
scripts.package:mac: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64"
scripts.package:windows: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --arm64"
scripts.package:linux: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --arm64"
scripts.package:dir:unsigned: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=false"
scripts.package:dmg: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never"
scripts.dist:mac: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null"
scripts.dist:windows: ../../scripts/build-lock.sh bash -c "npm run build:processes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --arm64 --publish never"
